logtarget.description: Target for Fail2Ban logs: file path (e.g., /var/log/fail2ban.log), SYSLOG, or STDERR

syslogfacility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., auth, daemon, local0)

bantime.description: Duration (in seconds) a host remains banned after triggering the limit

findtime.description: Time window (in seconds) during which failures are counted toward the ban threshold

maxretry.description: Maximum number of failures within `findtime` before banning the host

backend.description: Log monitoring backend: auto, inotify, poll, systemd, etc.

banaction.description: Default action to ban an IP (e.g., iptables-multiport, firewalld-multiport-port, iptables-ipset-proto6)

unbanaction.description: Action to unban a previously banned IP

use_dns.description: Whether to perform reverse DNS lookups on IPs; enable only if needed

ignoreip.description: List of IP addresses or networks that will never be banned

mta.description: Mail transfer agent for sending alerts: sendmail, postfix, or smtp

destemail.description: Recipient email address for ban/unban alerts

chain.description: Firewall chain for iptables rules (e.g., INPUT, FORWARD, OUTPUT)

protocol.description: Protocol(s) to monitor: tcp, udp, or tcpudp

description.description: Human-readable description for documentation (not used by Fail2Ban)

port.description: Port(s) to monitor (comma-separated as string in rendered config)

filter.description: Name of the filter file (in /etc/fail2ban/filter.d/) to parse logs

logpath.description: Log files to monitor for this jail

maxretry.description: Per-jail override for maxretry; uses global default if omitted

action.description: Action(s) to take on ban (e.g., iptables-multiport, sendmail-whois)

jails.description: List of jail definitions (each defines a service to protect, e.g., sshd, postfix)
